main.rule: Preserve full original intro. Hide native menu glyphs/pointer only after actual Main is ready; never crop to the top144px.

pause-options.rule: Use options-responsive-art above separate controls. It joins two untouched original fragments; the native8px password-label row is omitted. story.rule: Show complete original advisor+strategic map. Strip only original font480..4DE over true native background; fifth row overlaps the map. Original gold choice areas have genuine black background outside advisor/map; reflow the actual native message below.

cinematics.rule: Keep the complete native canvas and original cadence, including the original black surrounding frame. A single reference PNG is not an animation replacement.

results-ending.rule: Keep full original stats/background/extended artwork and ending/credits. Do not substitute cropped soldiers or a separately calculated scoreboard.

optionsFullNativeComposition.scope: Preserve the complete helmet, shoulder launcher, terrain and native320×224 geometry. No skipped rows, cropping, inpainting, recolour or generated patterns. Native glass covers unrecoverable baked words; it is not claimed hidden image reconstruction. Each glass panel repeats only the native1px horizontal strip between exact8px caps.
optionsFullNativeComposition.reconstructionPolicy: Every changed RGB pixel is copied from an explicitly recorded clean tile in this same original Options bitmap, with declared optional H/V flips. Geometry, dimensions, all uncovered pixels and palette are preserved. Candidate selection is a context heuristic, not a claim of authentic concealed pixels. No AI image, painting, interpolation or new color.
